announcements.headline: 2026 Interim Dividend - Exchange Rate
announcements.insight: This announcement clarifies the FX methodology for the interim dividend rather than declaring a new payout level, indicating no immediate change to shareholder yield expectations. In the current high-rate environment, SHC's focus remains on preserving NAV through prudent capital allocation rather than aggressive income expansion.
